texts: I keep snapping at my team at work, and I want a doha reminding me that gentle, kind words win hearts far faster than harsh orders, and that how we talk matters more than what we own.
hey can u write a doha about talking nicely to people
O let my words fall soft as blessings, that every ear which hears me is made glad.
My mother-in-law stopped talking to me for a month after one thing I said at dinner.
kind words win hearts
temple well, kind words
At the temple well this morning the women were quarreling until one old lady spoke so gently that everyone went quiet and smiled.
Words poured out at the temple like water drawn from a well, cooling every weary pilgrim who hears them.
Write a doha about how sweet speech is like water drawn from a deep well outside a temple, refreshing everyone who comes near, while rough words leave a person parched and unwelcome.
need a doha on speaking softly, maybe with a temple and a well in it
Let my voice carry the fragrance of sandalwood, cooling every heart it touches.
sandalwood words
I want a couplet saying that gentle talk is like sandalwood paste on a feverish brow, cooling the listener and perfuming the speaker too, so we should choose each word with great care.
can you do a doha where sandalwood stands for kind talk?
My brother's temper melted the moment I spoke softly to him, so I bought him sandalwood soap to celebrate.
Give me a doha about how a cuckoo wins everyone with its sweet song while a roaring lion is feared and avoided, showing that gentle speaking makes friends and harsh speaking drives them away.
doha pls: cuckoo vs lion, sweet voice vs scary voice
cuckoo, lion, voice
The cuckoo sings and the whole valley leans in to listen; the lion roars and the valley empties. Teach me which voice to choose.
My boss bellows like a lion at every meeting, while the new girl speaks softly like a cuckoo and gets everything done. How should I talk?
A doha, please, about how a single kind sentence is worth more than a diamond, and how real goodness spreads quietly like the scent of a musk deer that wanders about unaware of its own fragrance.
A diamond glitters but a gentle word warms; the musk deer carries its perfume unknowing, as a sweet speaker carries joy.
My grandmother never wore a diamond, yet the whole village sought her out just to hear her kind way of talking, like a musk deer trailing perfume.
musk deer, diamond, soft words
wanna doha on how nice words beat a diamond any day, maybe a musk deer in it too
The moneylender in our lane never raises his voice, even when collecting dues, and somehow people respect him more than the loud ones.
I need a doha on how a moneylender who speaks politely keeps his customers while a rude one loses them all, showing that courtesy in talk is the real capital in dealing with others.
lol the moneylender near me is so polite, can u make a doha on that kinda talk
moneylender, polite words
The moneylender counts his coins, yet it is his gentle greeting that people remember at night.
The crossroads is full of shouting, but one calm voice carrying a milk-soft kindness turns every stranger into a friend.
Doha on a gentle word that is like milk, soothing and nourishing, while a bitter word sours everything it touches, all spoken at a busy crossroads where people meet and part each day.
milk, crossroads, gentle talk
A fight broke out at the crossroads yesterday, until an old man spoke softly and handed a child some milk; the whole crowd calmed down.
can u make a doha, polite words at a crossroads, with milk in it somehow
priest, moneylender, soft words

Write a doha about how both the priest and the moneylender earn trust only when their talk is gentle, not when they preach or demand, because people open up to kindness more than to authority or rank.
hey doha idea: priest and moneylender, sweet talking wins every time
The priest speaks in blessings, the moneylender in numbers, yet only the one whose words are tender is welcome at every threshold.
My friend the priest and the moneylender in the next lane both swear that being soft-spoken has paid them more than all their cleverness.
Our washerman by the river hums softly and speaks kindly to everyone, and not one customer has ever walked away angry from him.
need a doha on watching what u say, washerman and river vibes
Like the washerman rinsing the river's edge, let me wash each word clean in kindness before it leaves my lips.
I want a doha about how one should rinse harsh words clean the way a washerman does beside a river, so that only soft and cleansed talk reaches others, since ugly words stain the one who hears them.
washerman, river, gentle talk
Every morning my uncle talks gently to his pet in its cage, and he says kind words are never wasted, even on the smallest creature.
The caged one is loved not for its colours but for its voice; so too we are cherished for what we say.
Give me a doha where a cage can hold a body but never the sweetness of words, showing that careful, loving talk is the real freedom of a person and cannot be locked away by anyone.
cage, sweet speech
yo write a doha bout kind words, a cage somewhere in it
inn, dew, gentle words
Soft words settle on the weary like dew at dawn, and the tired guest at the inn forgets his aching road.
hey can u write a doha about talking sweetly to a stranger at an inn, dew mention if possible
At the inn this morning a tired guest was spoken to so gently that he left lighter, as fresh as the dew outside.
I would like a doha explaining that a kind greeting offered to guests at an inn stays like morning dew in memory, soft and fresh, while harsh talk leaves only bitterness that lingers for years.
churn, kind talk
The more the churn is turned, the more butter comes; the more kindly I speak, the more love returns to me.
My neighbour turns her churn each dawn and says kind things to every passerby; her words are as good as her butter.
Please write a doha on how words, like a churn, bring out the best when worked gently and with patience, while violent shaking spoils the butter and breaks the bond between people who talk.
yaar need a doha with a churn and sweet words, thx
Kind words can move a mountain of resentment, while one harsh word cannot shift even a grain of it.
My son asked me why papa shouts so much, and I realised the mountain of anger I carry can only be climbed down by talking softly.
doha about how a few sweet words can crack a mountain of anger? something like that
Can you compose a couplet telling that even a towering mountain of pride and hatred in another person can be melted by patient, loving, humble talk, whereas shouting only makes it taller and harder?
mountain, gentle words
a doha for my oil press signboard? something on how a chakor bird of a voice draws customers
The chakor gazes at the sky with pure longing; let my words be that gentle, that devoted to the listener.
At the oil press, the old owner chats with everyone in such a warm voice that even the chakor bird he keeps seems to listen.
chakor, oil press, kind words
Write me a doha about how pleasant talk at the oil press keeps everyone returning, and how a chakor bird that sings softly is cherished far more than a loud one that only makes noise all day.
A doha for me please about how one thoughtless sentence said in anger can wound a friend for years, while a single warm, carefully chosen sentence can heal it, so we must guard what we say.
Words once flown cannot be recalled; let mine be only tender, only true, only kind.
careful, kind talk
can u make a doha on how mean comments hurt more than slaps
My daughter stopped confiding in me after I laughed at her answer in front of her friends, and now I long to make it right.
At the inn last night, the cook greeted everyone by name in such a warm voice that even the grumpiest guest ended up smiling.
I'd like a doha about how a person who speaks gently to the guests at an inn is loved more than the owner of the grandest rooms, because kind talk is the best hospitality one can give.
Under the inn's roof the words of welcome shelter the stranger better than walls ever could.
doha for an inn keeper abt talking nicely to guests
inn, kind welcome
doha on sweet talk with a tree and a tilak, my grandpa style
tree, tilak, gentle words
Please write a doha about how the sacred mark on one's forehead means little if the voice beneath it is harsh, and a person who speaks kindly is like a tree giving shade to everyone passing by.
The tree gives shade to all who rest beneath it; the gentle speaker gives rest to all who hear him, though his tilak be plain.
My uncle wears a bold tilak and sits under the old tree each evening, but his sharp talk drives everyone away.
My aunt makes pots from clay and her sweet manner of talking to customers sells more than any decoration, even the bitter gourd she grows cannot spoil her mood.
doha about kind speaking, bitter gourd and a potter, hmm weird combo but try

Compose a doha showing that a bitter gourd stays bitter however it is cooked, but a potter shapes clay with gentle hands, and likewise soft words can mould a hard heart where harsh words only break it.
The potter shapes the clay with tender palms; the bitter gourd remains bitter, as a harsh voice remains unloved.
potter, bitter gourd, kind words
My neighbour who sells diamonds is the nicest person on the street, always greeting people so warmly that rich and poor alike trust him.
doha: diamond doesnt shine as much as sweet words do
diamond, soft voice
Write a doha saying that a diamond may sparkle and cost a fortune, but a warm and pleasing way of speaking shines brighter in the eyes of everyone, and costs the speaker nothing at all.
The diamond dazzles for a moment, but a tender word glows in the memory for years.
Compose a doha on how a harsh word pricks like a thorn and stays lodged in the listener for years, while kind talk is smooth and soothing, so one should be careful before opening one's mouth.
thorn, hurtful words
doha pls, rude words are like a thorn that stays
After my cousin said that nasty line at the wedding, it went into me like a thorn and I still feel it every time we meet.
The thorn of a cruel word hides long in the flesh; let me sow only blossoms with my voice.
doha idea: date palm tall but gives no shade, like rude people with fancy words
date palm, humble talk
The date palm rises high but its fruit is out of reach; so is one who speaks proudly and gives no comfort to those below.
The date palm outside my school is tall, and so is our principal, but she speaks so gently to the youngest children that they run to her.
Please write a doha explaining that being tall and important like a date palm means nothing if your talk is harsh, because the fruit stays out of reach, while a gentle speaker is easily approached.

I want a doha that says kind words are rarer than a pearl and more nourishing than the fruit of a date palm, and everyone who learns to speak softly will find respect without ever having to demand it.
date palm, pearl, kind words
Our village elder lives beside a date palm and never wore a pearl, yet every young person goes to him just because of how gently he speaks.
More precious than any pearl is the gentle word, sweeter than the date palm's fruit, and given free.
can u make a doha where nice words are like pearls hanging from a date palm lol

Please write a doha about how a quick temper often shows itself in words that cannot be taken back, and how a calm, loving way of talking can save friendships, families and entire communities from lasting sorrow.
hey can u make a doha on speaking gently with family
I yelled at my parents last night over something silly, and now I cannot even look at them, so I need to find the right way to say sorry.
gentle words, kind tone
Let my lips carry only tenderness, and each sentence be a gift.
The lion's roar empties the plain, but a soft voice gathers all; teach me to speak like the second.
My father is a big man whom everyone fears like a lion, but when he talks softly to the baby the whole room melts.
Write a doha showing that a lion may be strong yet people only respect him from far, whereas a person with gentle, truthful and pleasing talk is loved by everyone near and far.
doha on talking softly even if ur strong like a lion
lion, soft voice
doha about gentle talk, a date palm and a yogi, thanks
The yogi bows in silence beneath the date palm, yet his few soft words feed more souls than its fruit.
The yogi who sits under the date palm near our village speaks so kindly to every visitor that even angry men leave calm.
Write me a couplet on how a yogi's true wealth is his gentle manner of speaking, which like the date palm's fruit feeds all who come near without asking anything in return.
yogi, date palm, kind words

I would like a doha showing that words are like the cloud which can bring either life-giving rain or a destructive storm, so one should speak with thought and gentleness to nourish others rather than to flood them.
doha idea: words are like clouds, can bring rain or storm
A cloud of kind words drifts over the parched, and pours its blessing in silence.
cloud, gentle words
When my sister speaks, she is like a cloud before rain, calm and giving; my brother is the thunder that frightens everyone.
speak softly always
My teacher never once raised his voice at us, yet we obeyed him more than the headmaster who shouted, and I wish to be like him.
I want a doha telling us that anyone who speaks sweetly wins friends everywhere, while a harsh speaker walks alone, and that this costs nothing yet it earns more than any amount of money or power.
Speak so that the listener's burdens grow light, and the morning of conversation turns bright.
can u write a doha about being nice in the way we talk
At my uncle's funeral, with the bier set down outside, the one thing everyone recalled was how softly he had always spoken to them.
bier, kind words remembered
When the bier is lifted, nothing travels with us but the memory of the gentle things we said.
doha plz on how ppl remember ur nice words at the end, bier and all
Write a doha showing that when the bier is carried out, the only thing mourners recall is whether the departed spoke gently and kindly, so we must fill our days with warm words before it is too late.
hey write something short about saying kind things to people

Please compose a doha on how the habit of speaking kindly takes no effort, costs no money, and yet gives the speaker a clear conscience and many true friends, while harsh talk leaves only enemies and regrets.
Let each word that leaves my lips be a small blessing for someone who needs it today.
gentle talk, loving manner
My colleague never criticizes anyone, and somehow everyone in the office brings their troubles to her first.
I want a doha telling that turning prayer beads while speaking harshly is useless, because real worship is shown in how softly and truthfully we talk to the people around us every single day.
The beads slip through the fingers, but what matters is the word that slips from the lips.
prayer beads, kind speech
doha about how u can chant with prayer beads all day but still talk rudely, that needs fixing
My mother counts her prayer beads every morning, then scolds the maid for an hour; I wish she would hear how that sounds.
The new neighbour smiled and said something so kind to my crying child that I decided to be that gentle with everyone from now on.
can u write me a doha about how sweet words melt people
soft words, big effect
A tender sentence lights the face of the weary like the first dawn after a long night.
Give me a doha that says a person is known by the way he speaks, that sweet and truthful words open every heart in the world, and rude words close them forever, no matter how rich one is.
The goldsmith in our street sells nothing but gold, yet his reputation rests on the arrow-straight honesty and soft words he gives each buyer.
gold, arrow, sharp words
A word is an arrow that never returns to the bow; better to give gold than to let a cruel word loose.
doha idea: harsh words hit like an arrow, kind words are worth more than gold

Write a doha showing that gold can be lost or stolen but a gentle word, once given, enriches the listener forever, while a bitter word shot like an arrow wounds and cannot be called back by any apology.
Please write a doha about how what we say shapes who we become: flattering words mislead, harsh words wound, but kind and truthful words build trust that lasts through every storm of life.
doha on being careful with what u say to ppl pls
After I told my friend exactly what I thought of her plans, she never called again; I would like to speak better next time.
Speak as though each word were a guest you are welcoming to a stranger's ear.
choose your words
The thief who tried to rob us was calmed down by my grandmother's gentle words by the river, and he left without taking anything.
The thief at the river's bank is disarmed not by force but by a voice made of kindness.
I want a doha about how soft, caring words can stop even a thief from his crime, while shouting and cursing only hardens him, and how the river of sweet talk flows to the hardest of hearts.
thief, river, soft voice
doha where kind words stop a thief by the river, kinda funny but ok
need a doha on speaking nicely to elders and kids alike
My little brother copies every harsh thing I say to him, and now I realise I must change how I talk before he turns out like me.
polite, gentle voice
Compose a doha on how a courteous and loving way of talking makes everyone from a small child to a king feel respected, and how that respect returns to us a hundredfold in later years.
May my speech be a quiet stream of kindness, that none who meets me departs unwarmed.
Write a doha showing that a harsh word flies like an arrow from the mouth and pierces another's heart, and once let loose it cannot be taken back, so one should speak only after thinking.
Last week I said something cutting to my wife, and it went in like an arrow; I would like to mend it with kinder words.
The arrow once loosed finds its mark; a cruel word is no different, so measure each before you send it.
doha about words being like arrows, plz
arrow, sharp words
hey doha about kind talk and a weaver's loom?
loom, gentle words

Please write a doha showing that as the weaver patiently makes cloth on the loom, a speaker must patiently choose and join gentle words, because careless talk comes apart and ruins the whole pattern of friendship.
My neighbour spends all day at his loom, yet his voice stays so calm and kind that children gather around him to listen.
On the loom of the day, let me weave only soft words into the fabric of every meeting.
The cleric calls the faithful with a voice made of tenderness, and hearts bow without being asked.
The cleric at our corner speaks so gently with everyone, Hindu or Muslim, that even our quarrelsome families end up listening to him.
doha on how a cleric's kind words matter more than his loud sermons
Write a doha showing that a cleric who speaks gently to the poor and the proud alike does more good than a hundred loud sermons, since sweetness in talk is itself a form of devotion.
cleric, gentle voice
loom, soft talk
u can do a doha on kind talk and a loom right
My grandfather used to sit at his loom and talk to us in such a warm voice that I still hear it whenever life gets rough.
Compose a doha on how a weaver's loom makes beautiful cloth only if each strand is laid with care, and in the same way, patient and loving words create harmony in every family and community.
On the loom of life, let each word be laid down tenderly, and the pattern will be love.
Our village grindstone stopped for the day, and while the women waited, one spoke so cheerfully to the rest that no one noticed the long hours.
The grindstone turns and breaks the grain, but a kind word in a weary hour grinds away sorrow.
grindstone, kind words
doha pls, kind talk vs the grindstone, how harsh words grind people down
Please write a doha on how harsh words grind a person down like a grindstone crushing grain, whereas gentle talk preserves and nourishes, so we must be gentle with all we speak to.
I was shouting at my boss in my head all day, but then I said one calm thing and the mountain of tension in our office just crumbled.
A gentle voice has taught the stubborn mountain to bow, and the wild wind to rest.
doha on how mountains of anger melt with soft words
mountain, sweet talk
Write a doha which says that a stubborn mountain of ego in a person can be gently shifted by steady, kind, patient words, whereas loud demands only make it harder and more immovable.
The old man who works the oil press never raises his voice at his helpers, and they stay with him year after year.
The oil press yields its gift only to patient pressing; so do hearts yield only to patient, tender words.
doha with an oil press and sweet talking, any vibe
oil press, soft words
Write me a doha showing that just as the oil press must be turned slowly and steadily to give its best, a person must be addressed with slow, gentle and loving words to bring out the goodness in him.
The bitter gourd stays bitter though dipped in nectar; so a harsh heart stays harsh unless softened by tender words.
Write a doha that compares a harsh speaker to a bitter gourd, which no cook can sweeten however long it simmers, and says that one should keep sweetness in speech so that others take in nourishment.
My brother-in-law complains about everything, like a bitter gourd at the table, while his wife speaks kindly and keeps the family together.
bitter gourd, harsh talk
doha: bitter gourd = rude talking, can u do that
The blind man hears the heart through the voice; teach us all to speak so that kindness is seen by the unseeing.
A blind man in our lane can tell who is kind just from how they talk, and he says tone matters more than looks.
blind man, kind voice
can u write a doha about how a blind man knows who's nice just from their words
Please write a doha showing that a blind man recognises good people not by their faces but by the sweetness of their words, so we should all take care to speak kindly since everyone is listening.
lion, gentle words
Write a doha showing that the lion rules the wilds by fear and is avoided, while one who speaks with kindness and gentleness rules hearts everywhere and never needs to threaten anyone.
My boss roars like a lion in every meeting and the whole team has stopped sharing ideas with him.
The lion's roar scatters the herd; the soft call of kindness gathers it.
doha idea: lion = harsh talking, kindness wins
house, chakor, kind words
The chakor keeps its eyes on the sky, and a good house keeps its walls warm with gentle words.
Please write a doha showing that a house filled with soft, loving words is better than a grand house full of shouting, and that the chakor bird sings best where it feels safe and treated gently.
doha about kind words keeping a house happy, with a chakor bird in it
Our house has a chakor bird that sings only when we speak softly to it, and since then we have all stopped shouting at each other.
can u write a doha on a palace guard talking politely to a poor man
The palace walls are high, but the humblest voice speaks softest, and the king hears it first.
At the palace visit, the guard spoke so kindly to our poor old aunt that she cried and said no one had been so gentle in years.
I want a doha about how a person who lives in a palace is truly noble only when he speaks gently to the poorest person who comes to him, since rank without kind words is empty.
palace, polite words

Compose a doha about a date palm that bows with fruit and a lotus that stays unsoiled in muddy water, both showing that a gentle speaker remains unstained by the quarrels around him and gives freely to all.
The lotus blooms untouched by mud, the date palm gives freely; so let my speech be gentle in a muddy world.
doha with a lotus and a date palm for kind words
Our colleague stays unruffled in every office quarrel and speaks gently to all, and it reminds me of a lotus beside a tall date palm.
lotus, date palm, soft words
Please write a doha on how the words we speak are the only possession that grows when it is shared kindly, since love given in speech returns to us many times over, while cruelty returns as grief.
I used to answer everyone sharply, and since I began greeting people warmly my whole life feels easier and more peaceful.
doha on talkin sweet to everyone including strangers
Let me speak like morning prayer, humble and bright, that all who hear me are blessed.
sweet, gentle talk
My neighbour said one warm thing to my sulking son, and he smiled for the first time all week.
warm words heal
One kind sentence, freely given, can mend what months of silence broke.
can u make a doha on how a few nice words can fix someones day
Write a doha showing that the way we speak to others, whether strangers, servants, or family, reveals our true nature, and that gentle words are the best ornament a person can ever wear.
